product_target.product_bottleneck: normal AUTO SSD-streaming decode with routed-expert I/O
product_target.claim_boundary: 8K exploration may reject but cannot promote; a survivor still requires the canonical matrix, 32K and endpoint gates

sampling.implementation: ds4-bench transactional greedy argmax; EOS is an ordinary fixed-horizon token

memory_comparison.comparison_kind: normal-AUTO product comparison; not equal instantaneous memory
memory_comparison.normalization_forbidden: do not normalize throughput or latency by bytes, cache records, static footprint or runtime footprint

policy_reference_before_8k_tier.role: input to policy derivation only; not the post-prefill A cache count

mapped_artifact.note: mmap-backed file size is identity evidence, not an assertion that every byte is resident

system_python.only_permitted_skip: optional MLX is not installed in the system-Python control lane

oracle.support_authentication: hash the external SUPPORT GGUF exactly once before either oracle; require device, inode, byte size and mtime to remain unchanged through both oracle runs

binary_identity.build_git: exact first 12 hexadecimal characters of that worktree HEAD, with no dirty suffix
binary_identity.comparison_revision: A and B use byte-identical clean builds from the same exact main commit; only the authenticated model artifact changes

execution_readiness.blocker: production DSpark N>1 proposal and exact verifier are not connected to generation blocks; combined AUTO remains admission-closed
execution_readiness.required_preflight: one identical clean main commit and byte-identical Metal ds4-bench build for A and B; transactional fixed-horizon decode; candidate normal AUTO resolves to the production DSpark SSD path

frontier_logits.comparison: canonical JSON SHA-256 after excluding source and model identity fields

parity.known_gap: the schema name says qwen but ds4-bench emits this same model-neutral token/final-logit payload for DeepSeek; validation checks the emitted schema and content rather than inventing another format

metrics.required_candidate_effect: must exceed absolute A1/A2 drift and B1/B2 spread

post_validation.outcome: prepared but execution-blocked until the production DSpark N>1 proposal/verifier and AUTO-to-SSD path exist; once unblocked, an exact safe 8K result is only a survivor and release promotion still requires measured resolution and the remaining context/model lanes

cohort_invalidation: any nonzero arm rc, result_error or abort_reason
any competing inference process or unavailable process telemetry
any pressure, wired-memory, RSS or swap telemetry failure
any model, SUPPORT-oracle artifact, executable build-Git, repository diff, Metal-source or prompt identity change
any tracked worktree diff in a retained arm, even when the same diff repeats
oracle test-count drift or any MLX-lane skip
AUTO does not resolve to SSD
resolved plan or cache budget changes within A or within B
A1/A2 primary control drift exceeds 3 percent
host power, OS, physical memory or cache-state mismatch
